reason: Both are restaurant operators and brand owners that earn franchise or license income and sell food to consumers. The Wendy's Company is a mass-market quick-service burger chain, mostly franchised, with drive-thru service. The ONE Group runs upscale "vibe dining" brands (STK, Benihana, Kona Grill, RA Sushi) that are mostly company-operated, plus hotel food and beverage management. The restaurant category and the diner base overlap, but the segment, price point and dining occasion differ, so this is adjacent and not a direct competitor.
